Proposition
[local metric subsequence convergence] Source: cao-zhu 1. Claim 1\group Cao–Zhu Cheeger Type Compactness By passing to another subsequence we can guarantee that for each $\alpha $ (and indeed all $\alpha $ by diagonalization) the metrics $g_k^{\alpha }$ (or $\bar g_k^{\alpha }$ or ${\bar{\bar g}}_k^{\alpha }$) converge uniformly with their derivatives to a smooth metric $g^{\alpha }$ (or $\bar g^{\alpha }$ or ${\bar{\bar g}}^{\alpha }$) on $E^{\alpha }$ (or $\bar E^{\alpha }$ or ${\bar{\bar E}}^{\alpha }$) which is also in geodesic coordinates.
